subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should this Codex warning fix require live app-server proof before merge, or is sibling Codex source-contract proof plus focused OpenClaw tests sufficient?
rationale: The code direction is sound, but current OpenClaw projection evidence leaves the exact reported producer path unproven; accepting source-contract proof instead of live behavior proof is a maintainer judgment.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until the contributor refreshes the branch and adds redacted live Codex app-server output, logs, or a recording covering read-only and mutating failures.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the sibling Codex source contract and focused OpenClaw tests as sufficient despite the missing live app-server turn.

options.title: Pause or close if proof does not arrive
options.body: If the contributor does not refresh the branch or provide proof after the cleanup window, maintainers can close this PR and keep the canonical issue open for a replacement fix.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until the contributor refreshes the branch and adds redacted live Codex app-server output, logs, or a recording covering read-only and mutating failures.
